title: What a Godly Man Does With His Phone During the Sermon (It's Not What You Think)
caption:
Silent mode doesn't kill the pull. It just kills the sound. Your hand still knows exactly where the phone is the whole hour.

A godly man decides this in the parking lot, not mid-sermon. Off, not silent, so temptation never gets a vote. What a distracted man misses, he never even finds out he lost.

Try it once. Off, not silent, for one sermon.

#faith #phonefree #christianmen #discipline #manofgod
